title: Murwere Asingazununguki
intro: Munhoroondo dzenhoroondo dzeuprofita, vashoma vakatsungirira kurasikirwa kukuru kwakadaro uye matambudziko emuviri nekutenda kusingazununguki. Nyaya yemunhu uyu chidzidzo chisingaperi chekushivirira nekuvimba neuchenjeri hwaMwari. Mweya uyu ndiani?
clues: Ndakasarudzwa naAllah kuti nditaure shoko, asi muedzo wangu mukuru hauna kuuya nekurambwa, asi nenjodzi yangu.
Pfuma yangu, zvipfuwo zvangu, nevana vangu zvakatorwa kubva kwandiri, chimwe nechimwe chichitevera chimwe.
Muviri wangu wakanga wakazara nemaronda, uye ndakasiiwa ndega kunze kwekutsigirwa nemurume wangu.
Ndakachema kuna Ishe wangu, ndichibvuma kutambura kwangu uye ndichikumbira tsitsi dzake.
Ndakarayirwa kuti ndirove pasi netsoka yangu, uye chitubu chinozorodza chakabuda.
Mwari vakadzoreredza hutano hwangu uye vakandipa mhuri itsva uye pfuma yakawanda kupfuura yandaiva nayo kare.
arabic: وَٱذْكُرْ عَبْدَنَآ أَيُّوبَ إِذْ نَادَىٰ رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنِّى مَسَّنِىَ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنُ بِنُصْبٍۢ وَعَذَابٍ
verse: And remember Our servant Job, when he called to his Lord, "Indeed, Satan has touched me with hardship and torment." (38:41)
